an-sep-continuity.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Continuity and Infinitesimals
an-sep-continuity.notes: Cauchy, Weierstrass and Dedekind, nineteenth-century analytical rigor.

an-tao.title: Terence Tao, Analysis I

an-sep-dedekind.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Dedekind’s Contributions to the Foundations of Mathematics
an-sep-dedekind.notes: Dedekind cuts, publication in 1872, Cantor alternative.

an-openstax-calculus1-continuity.title: OpenStax, Calculus Volume 1, Section 2.4: Continuity

an-openstax-calculus1-precise-limits.title: OpenStax, Calculus Volume 1, Section 2.5: The Precise Definition of a Limit
an-openstax-calculus1-precise-limits.notes: Epsilon-delta proofs, local bounds, and counterexamples.

an-openstax-calculus1-extrema.title: OpenStax, Calculus Volume 1, Section 4.3: Maxima and Minima
an-openstax-calculus1-extrema.notes: Absolute extrema and the extreme value theorem; full proof supplied in lecture companion.

an-openstax-calculus1-derivative.notes: Difference quotients, instantaneous slope, velocity and derivative definitions.

an-openstax-calculus1-definite-integral.notes: Riemann sums, definite integral, integrability, and signed area.

an-openstax-calculus1-ftc.title: OpenStax, Calculus Volume 1, Section 5.3: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus

an-wiki-mvt.notes: Proof via Rolle theorem and global derivative consequences.

an-wiki-riemann-integral.title: Wikipedia, Riemann integral
an-wiki-riemann-integral.notes: Tagged sums, Darboux sums, integrability and counterexamples.

an-wiki-ftc.title: Wikipedia, Fundamental theorem of calculus
an-wiki-ftc.notes: Precise theorems linking integral, derivative and antiderivative.

an-wiki-metric-space.title: Wikipedia, Metric space
an-wiki-metric-space.notes: Definitions and examples of metric spaces, including complete and totally bounded cases.

an-wiki-complete-metric.title: Wikipedia, Complete metric space
an-wiki-complete-metric.notes: Cauchy sequences and completeness, including uniform metrics on functions.

an-wiki-compact.title: Wikipedia, Compact space
an-wiki-compact.notes: Finite subcovers, continuous images, and sequential compactness in metric spaces.

an-wiki-totally-bounded.title: Wikipedia, Totally bounded space
an-wiki-totally-bounded.notes: Finite epsilon-ball covers; complete and totally bounded metric spaces.

an-wiki-heine-cantor.title: Wikipedia, Heine–Cantor theorem
an-wiki-heine-cantor.notes: Uniform continuity on compact metric spaces.

an-wiki-heine-borel.title: Wikipedia, Heine–Borel theorem
an-wiki-heine-borel.notes: Closed and bounded characterization in Euclidean spaces.

an-wiki-uniform-convergence.title: Wikipedia, Uniform convergence
an-wiki-uniform-convergence.notes: Uniform vs pointwise convergence and conditions for exchanging limits.

an-wiki-mtest.title: Wikipedia, Weierstrass M-test
an-wiki-mtest.notes: Sufficient numerical-majorant criterion for uniform convergence.

an-wiki-power-series.title: Wikipedia, Power series
an-wiki-power-series.notes: Convergence radius, subdisk bounds, termwise differentiation.

an-washington-series.title: University of Washington, Series notes

an-ash-complex.title: Robert B. Ash and W. P. Novinger, Complex Variables, second edition (Dover, 2004)
an-ash-complex.notes: Complete freely accessible graduate-level text: Cauchy theory, power series, and conformal maps. Authorship checked against the PDF title page.

an-mit-complex-theory.title: MIT OpenCourseWare, 18.112 Functions of a Complex Variable, Fall 2008 lecture notes
an-mit-complex-theory.notes: Complex algebra, holomorphic maps, line integrals, Cauchy–Goursat theorem and integral formula.

an-mit-complex-applications.title: MIT OpenCourseWare, 18.04 Complex Variables with Applications, Spring 2018 lecture notes
an-mit-complex-applications.notes: Complex plane geometry, analytic functions, contour integration, integral formula and residues.

an-goursat-open-text.title: A First Course in Complex Analysis, The Cauchy–Goursat Theorem
an-goursat-open-text.notes: Precise hypotheses and subdivision proof of the holomorphic Cauchy–Goursat theorem.

an-wiki-complex.title: Wikipedia, Complex number
an-wiki-complex.notes: Arithmetic, conjugation, modulus, polar form and geometry.

an-wiki-cauchy-riemann.title: Wikipedia, Cauchy–Riemann equations
an-wiki-cauchy-riemann.notes: Necessary CR conditions, sufficient conditions with real differentiability and geometry.

an-wiki-contour.title: Wikipedia, Contour integration
an-wiki-contour.notes: Parametrization, orientation, contour estimates and winding.

an-wiki-cauchy-formula.title: Wikipedia, Cauchy's integral formula
an-wiki-cauchy-formula.notes: Value and derivative formulas, analytic consequences and estimates.

an-wiki-identity-theorem.title: Wikipedia, Identity theorem
an-wiki-identity-theorem.notes: Accumulating zeros, local analytic identity and connected-domain hypotheses.

an-wiki-analytic-continuation.title: Wikipedia, Analytic continuation
an-wiki-analytic-continuation.notes: Germs, overlapping Taylor disks and continuation along paths.

an-wiki-laurent.title: Wikipedia, Laurent series
an-wiki-laurent.notes: Annular expansion, coefficients, and principal part.

an-wiki-casorati.title: Wikipedia, Casorati–Weierstrass theorem
an-wiki-casorati.notes: Density of function values at an essential isolated singularity.

an-residue-open-text.title: A First Course in Complex Analysis, The Residue Theorem
an-residue-open-text.notes: Laurent coefficient interpretation and residue theorem.

an-wiki-residue.title: Wikipedia, Residue theorem
an-wiki-residue.notes: Residues, winding-weighted theorem and contour applications.

an-wiki-argument.title: Wikipedia, Argument principle
an-wiki-argument.notes: Logarithmic derivative, zero/pole count, winding number.

an-wiki-rouche.title: Wikipedia, Rouché’s theorem
an-wiki-rouche.notes: Strict boundary inequality and homotopy of zero counts.

an-harvard-harmonic.title: Harvard Math 55b, Complex Analysis course notes, harmonic functions
an-harvard-harmonic.notes: Harmonic conjugate existence on simply connected domains; Laplacian; examples.

an-iitg-harmonic.title: IIT Guwahati, MA547 Complex Analysis, Harmonic Functions and Conformal Mappings
an-iitg-harmonic.notes: Conjugate differential and global obstruction on punctured plane.

an-wisc-montel.title: University of Wisconsin, Math 722 Complex Analysis, Part 5 (Normal Families)
an-wisc-montel.notes: Arzelà–Ascoli, Cauchy bounds, Montel compactness and diagonal sequences.

an-jyu-complex2.title: Tero Kilpeläinen and Antti Vähäkangas, Complex Analysis 2 (Spring 2024), English translation by Mikko Salo
an-jyu-complex2.notes: Holomorphic convergence, Laurent expansions, residues and the Riemann mapping theorem.

an-wiki-open-mapping.title: Wikipedia, Open mapping theorem (complex analysis)

an-wiki-schwarz.title: Wikipedia, Schwarz lemma

an-wiki-poisson.title: Wikipedia, Poisson kernel

an-wiki-hurwitz.title: Wikipedia, Hurwitz's theorem (complex analysis)

an-wiki-mobius.title: Wikipedia, Möbius transformation

an-wiki-poincare-disk.title: Wikipedia, Poincaré disk model

an-wiki-poincare-halfplane.notes: Half-plane metric and isometry with disk.

an-wiki-schwarz-pick.title: Wikipedia, Schwarz–Pick theorem
an-wiki-schwarz-pick.notes: Hyperbolic contraction theorem and equality case.

an-emory-riemann-mapping.title: Guangqiu Liang, Riemann Mapping Theorem, Emory University (2020)
an-emory-riemann-mapping.notes: Normalized extremal-derivative proof, square-root omission argument.

an-harvard-conformal-mapping.title: Yum-Tong Siu, Math 213a (2024), Schwarz-Christoffel Transformations (includes a Riemann mapping theorem section)
an-harvard-conformal-mapping.notes: Schwarz–Christoffel factors, polygonal corners and a section on the Riemann mapping theorem.

an-qmul-potential.title: Boris Khoruzhenko, LTCC Potential Theory lecture notes (Queen Mary University of London, 2011)
an-qmul-potential.notes: Harmonic functions, Poisson formula, Dirichlet problem, and harmonic measure. This is not a source for the Carathéodory boundary-extension theorem.

an-wiki-caratheodory.title: Wikipedia, Carathéodory's theorem (conformal mapping)
an-wiki-caratheodory.notes: Jordan boundaries and conformal maps of closures.

an-mit-real-2025.title: MIT OpenCourseWare, 18.100B Real Analysis, Spring 2025, lecture notes 1–22
an-mit-real-2025.notes: Lectures 4–7 sequences; 11–14 metric topology; 15–19 differential and integral calculus; 20–22 uniform convergence and series.

an-mit-metric-2023.title: MIT OpenCourseWare, 18.S190 Introduction to Metric Spaces, January 2023, lecture notes 1–5
an-mit-metric-2023.notes: Compactness, total boundedness, completeness, uniform continuity and metric-space examples.

an-bishop-conformal.title: Christopher J. Bishop, The Riemann Mapping Theorem, Stony Brook Math 626 lecture notes (2008–2010)
an-bishop-conformal.notes: Chapters 1–4 address Möbius maps, hyperbolic geometry, Schwarz–Christoffel maps, Riemann mapping, Carathéodory boundary extension and conformal modulus. Lecture notes are an unfinished draft.

an-axler-measure.title: Sheldon Axler, Measure, Integration & Real Analysis, Graduate Texts in Mathematics 282, Springer (2020; open access)
an-axler-measure.notes: Ch. 2A outer measure; 2B sigma-algebras and measurable functions; 2C measure axioms; 2D Lebesgue measure; 2E convergence of measurable functions; 3A Lebesgue integration and monotone convergence. Also covers dominated convergence, product measures, L-p theory, and Hilbert/Fourier analysis.

an-mit-measure-18125.title: MIT OpenCourseWare, 18.125 Measure and Integration, Prof. Jeff Viaclovsky (Fall 2003), lecture notes prepared by Ethan Brown
an-mit-measure-18125.notes: Lecture 1 sigma-algebras and Borel sets; 2 measurable functions/simple functions; 4 monotone convergence and Fatou; 5 dominated convergence; 6–9 Lebesgue measure; 13 Egoroff and convergence in measure. Lectures 14–15 Hölder, Minkowski and Riesz–Fischer; 18–20 product measures and Fubini–Tonelli.

an-tao-measure.title: Terence Tao, An Introduction to Measure Theory, Graduate Studies in Mathematics 126 (2011), online draft and lecture notes
an-tao-measure.notes: Alternative derivations of Lebesgue measure, measurability, nonmeasurable sets, and integration.

an-wiki-sigma.title: Wikipedia, Sigma-algebra
an-wiki-sigma.notes: Definitions, closure properties, examples and measurable spaces.

an-wiki-lebesgue.title: Wikipedia, Lebesgue measure
an-wiki-lebesgue.notes: Outer measure, Carathéodory criterion, nonmeasurability and null sets.

an-wiki-measurable.title: Wikipedia, Measurable function
an-wiki-measurable.notes: Borel preimages, measurable functions and pointwise limit closure.

an-wiki-mct.title: Wikipedia, Monotone convergence theorem (measure theory section)
